biggest_catch: Pay is per study and modest ($5-$45 for most studies) - occasional small payouts, not a meaningful income stream.
catches: 'Majority' of studies pay $5-$45 - some studies pay outside this range (disclosed before each study)
Some studies pay based on performance during the study, adding uncertainty
In-person studies are in Charlottesville, VA - local availability matters
Studies arrive by email invitation; frequency is not guaranteed
Session durations are not stated on the page

c1.evidence: darden.virginia.edu BRAD Lab 'For Participants' page (official UVA Darden domain, search index crawled 44 days before verification); pay range quoted verbatim

c2.evidence: Official lab page states: 'The majority of our studies pay $5-$45'

c3.evidence: Steps from official page: fill out the short form to join the participant pool; researchers email when eligible studies become available

c4.evidence: Free to join the pool; no fee; behavioral studies

eligibility: 18 or older; anyone may join the pool (UVA students verify status with UVA email)
notes: Standing participant pool of UVA Darden's Behavioral Research at Darden (BRAD) Lab. Page states the pay range covers the majority of studies and that exact compensation type/amount is always disclosed before each study. Payout numbers use the stated majority range ($5-$45 per study). Time is not stated on the page; the range is an honest typical-session estimate disclosed as such.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (majority of studies pay $5-$45 per study); time: typical behavioral study session estimate since page does not state durations
payout_quote: Compensation depends on the type and length of the study. The majority of our studies pay $5-$45. You will always be informed of the compensation type and amount prior to the study. In some studies, your compensation will be based on your performance during the study.
payout_value_note: Majority of studies pay $5-$45 per study; exact amount disclosed before each study; some studies are performance-based.

s1.note: Provider's own stated per-study range; no conversion

s2.note: Framed as occasional modest per-study pay, not steady income

steps: Fill out the short form on the BRAD Lab For Participants page to join the pool
Wait to be emailed when eligible studies become available
Review the stated compensation type and amount for each study
Participate in the study (online or in-person in Charlottesville)
Receive the stated compensation for the completed study
timing: Paid per completed study; disbursement method and timing not stated on the page.
